advancedConcurrentMediaHelp: Use 0 for no limit, which is the default. Once the limit is reached a new live view is refused and a new still is answered with that camera’s most recent picture, and a camera already open is never interrupted. Lower this if several cameras at once make live view stutter.
advancedConcurrentMediaInvalid: Enter a whole number of cameras greater than or equal to zero.
advancedDeviceHelp: Exposure, audio, and snapshot preferences for one device open from that device’s tile.
advancedFfmpegHelp: Leave blank to use the FFmpeg executable bundled with the plugin.
advancedPollingHelp: Use 0 to disable scheduled polling. The default is 10 minutes.
advancedPollingInvalid: Enter a whole number of minutes greater than or equal to zero.
advancedSaveFailed: The advanced setting could not be saved. Try again.
advancedSummary: Change infrequent host-level options. Save the Homebridge configuration when finished.
advancedWarmUpHelp: Choose the events that should open a camera’s connection as soon as it reports one, so the live view or snapshot straight afterwards starts immediately. Every camera is independent: an event opens only the camera that reported it, and only for the events chosen here. A camera running on its own battery is kept awake for several minutes each time, and one reporting often may never sleep; wired cameras and those behind a HomeBase are unaffected. Doorbell presses alone is the balanced choice.
advancedWarmUpRemove: Stop warming up the selected events
armingModesHelp: Four HomeKit states, nine station modes. Pick what each state sets; leave one empty to keep it out of HomeKit. Night has no default.
authCommitFailed: Signed in, but the session could not be saved. Restart Homebridge and sign in again.
authFailed: Authentication failed. Check the account details and try again.
authPluginRunning: Homebridge Eufy is using the account connection right now. Restart Homebridge, then sign in again.
authSaveFailed: Signed in, but the settings could not be saved. Press Save.
authSuccess: Authentication succeeded. Press Save below, then let Homebridge restart to start the new account connection.
authSummary: This temporary connection stays in the setup window and closes before your account is saved.
authTimedOut: Authentication timed out. Start again to create a fresh connection.
cameraOwnArming: This camera also appears as its own security system. It works without a HomeBase, so it keeps its own arming state rather than following one — which is why each standalone camera shows a separate security system in the Home app.
captchaRetry: That answer was not accepted. Enter the new captcha.
countryInvalid: Enter a two-letter country code, such as US or FR.
dashboardAuthenticationRequiredSummary: The saved account needs authentication before devices can reconnect.
dashboardDegradedSummary: Showing the last complete discovery while the connection recovers.
dashboardDegradedTitle: Devices from the last complete discovery
dashboardFailedSummary: Homebridge Eufy stopped on an error. Restart Homebridge.
dashboardIncompleteSummary: Device discovery is incomplete. Existing device information is retained until a complete discovery replaces it.
dashboardMissingSummary: No device snapshot is available yet. Start or restart Homebridge to discover devices.
dashboardOwnerConflictSummary: Another Homebridge Eufy process owns this account connection. Stop the other process before continuing.
dashboardReadySummary: These devices came from the latest complete discovery.
dashboardRestartRequiredSummary: These devices were found for the account you just signed in to. Press Save below, then let Homebridge restart to connect them.
dashboardStaleSummary: The saved device snapshot is no longer current. Restart Homebridge to refresh its status.
dashboardUnreachableSummary: The settings service did not answer. Reload this page.
diagnosticDescription: This device is recognized, but its primary capabilities do not have a verified HomeKit representation yet.
diagnosticNoAction: Nothing is wrong with your setup and there is nothing here to fix. It will appear in HomeKit once its main function has a representation verified against real hardware, so reporting it only helps if you can assist with that.
diagnosticsArchiveHandoff: Your browser saved {filename}, usually in Downloads. On GitHub, drag it into the Diagnostics Archive box without renaming it.
diagnosticsCaptureKeepsRunning: You can close this page; capture keeps running.
diagnosticsCollectingFinishHere: Debug diagnostics — collection is active. Finish here.
diagnosticsControlAction: Use the control once, wait for the device to settle, then finish when the wrong state is visible.
diagnosticsControlSummary: Checks what happens when a HomeKit control and the device disagree.
diagnosticsDashboardAction: Repeat the navigation, setting change, or save attempt once, then reopen Debug diagnostics from the bug icon to finish collecting.
diagnosticsDashboardSummary: Tracks a problem in the dashboard, login, or setup screens.
diagnosticsDevicesAction: Refresh the devices or reopen the affected tile, then finish when the problem appears.
diagnosticsDevicesSummary: Checks why a HomeKit accessory is missing, duplicated, or shown as the wrong type.
diagnosticsExistingIssue: Attach it to my existing issue
diagnosticsExpired: The previous collection session has ended. Start a new one when needed.
diagnosticsFailed: The diagnostics request failed. Try again.
diagnosticsInactive: Choose an issue profile to begin. Nothing is uploaded automatically.
diagnosticsLiveAction: Open the live view, request one snapshot, or try talkback once, then finish when the result is visible.
diagnosticsLiveSummary: Checks one live view, snapshot, or talkback problem.
diagnosticsMissingEvidence: Collection complete. Some diagnostic details were unavailable, but you can still continue.
diagnosticsOtherAction: Try to make the problem happen once, note what you see, and finish promptly.
diagnosticsOtherSummary: Collects details for a problem that does not fit another choice.
diagnosticsPrivacy: Nothing is uploaded. Passwords, private account data, and camera media are never included.
diagnosticsProfileChanged: Start a new diagnostics session to use this profile.
diagnosticsRecordingAction: Trigger one event that should be recorded, wait for the recording to appear, then finish.
diagnosticsRecordingSummary: Checks one missing or unplayable HomeKit Secure Video recording.
diagnosticsReproducing: Collection is active. Reproduce the problem, then finish.
diagnosticsStartupAction: Restart Homebridge or repeat the failed sign-in step, then return here and finish.
diagnosticsStartupSummary: Checks a Homebridge startup, connection, or sign-in problem.
diagnosticsSummary: Choose the problem, then collect what happens while it occurs.
firstSetupAcknowledgement: I have created a dedicated guest account and shared my Eufy home and devices with it.
firstSetupIntro: Create a separate Eufy account for Homebridge. From your personal account in the Eufy app, share your home and devices with that guest account.
firstSetupReasonBody: Your personal account stays active in the Eufy app on your phone. A separate account prevents the app and Homebridge from competing for the same session and interrupting either connection.
firstSetupTitle: Use a dedicated Eufy guest account
footnote: Independent and unofficial. Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Anker Innovations or eufy. "eufy" and "Anker" are trademarks of their respective owners. Use responsibly — rapid or failed logins can trigger captcha or temporary cooldowns.
legacySummary: These V4 settings were intentionally discarded. They were not migrated or executed.
oneAccountSession: One account session at a time
preferenceSaveFailed: The preference could not be saved. Try again.
reauthSummary: Homebridge Eufy can no longer use the saved Eufy session, so your devices are not updating in HomeKit. Sign in again to reconnect them.
sessionDetails: Sign-in, captcha, and verification will run here only after the plugin has stopped its existing Eufy connection. Your sign-in details stay within this setup flow.
shareLink: How to share your Eufy home
snapshotModeCloudDescription: Uses only a stored image without waking the camera.
snapshotModeHelp: Refresh suits most cameras and is the default. Choose Live if a picture is out of date and you would rather wait for a new one, or Cloud if waking this camera costs too much battery.
snapshotModeLiveDescription: Requests a fresh live image each time.
snapshotModeRefreshDescription: Returns the cached image immediately and refreshes it in the background at a limited rate.
twoFactorSent: Eufy has sent you a verification code. Enter it below.
updatePendingFailed: The restart could not be started. Restart Homebridge to use the installed version.
updatePendingManual: This page shows what the running version can do. Restart Homebridge to use the version you installed.
updatePendingSummary: This page shows what the running version can do. Restart to use the version you installed.
